title: Machine learning bedside score for invasive pulmonary aspergillosis in ICU patients
summary: In a prospective multicentre cohort, models derived from 508 patients (121 IPA) at one hospital were validated in 229 patients (53 IPA) from 15 other centres, with a CatBoost AUC of 0.844 and a bedside score built from nine predictors. Logistic regression was comparable or best in internal validation. The discrimination is moderate.
ai_technology: CatBoost and logistic regression models with a derived bedside score

evidence.tested: Diagnostic performance within 24 hours of ICU admission in an external validation cohort of 15 centres.
evidence.unknown: Moderate AUC; logistic regression comparable in internal validation; date shown is the issue date; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning models on admission data to diagnose invasive pulmonary aspergillosis.
